t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The ghomes will change colour and will take you to different coloured forests. The different coloured forests will change depending on different factors. The multiplier will be either 1x 2x 5x and this will take you to different ghnomes. There are 3 sets of gnomes, in pairs all different colours. The colours will change and correspond to different sets of points.

vb_textbox.text: Firstly, an important factor to understand is the gnomes will appear in fixed pairs; orange and brown, red and yellow, blue and purple and finally green and pink. Each gnome in a pair will lead you to a different forest, this will be represented by different colours. There are two types of forests and the orange, red, blue and green will take you to one type and the other set of gnomes will take you to the other forest.The number of mushrooms in each forest changes all the time. The best advice will be to do a sort of trial and error, by keeping close attention to which colours give you the most mushrooms. However, once the number starts lowering I would pick different colours as the number is constantly changing and you have to keep trying different tactics. If you maintain focus and recognise which colour leads to which forest and gives the most mushrooms, you will do well. Good luck!
